raw_html: [[Bane (enchantment)|Elemental Bane]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Bane (enchantment)|Elemental Bane]]:''' A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Elementals, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.
